description: Future transit stops and service frequencies for the Future scenario: projects not yet in the GTFS feeds, such as the RapidRide J and I Lines and Stride BRT, whatever their opening year
instructions: Add stops for planned or under-construction projects that aren't in the current GTFS feeds; remove them once they appear in a feed
notes: This file defines additional frequent transit stops for future years
These stops will be added to the existing GTFS data for visualization
Each stop should have coordinates, name, and service frequency information
Optional hourly_trips_saturday / hourly_trips_sunday give weekend service; stops without them reuse hourly_trips on weekends

RapidRide I Line stations (80, replacing Route 160): Metro station feature map data, https://metrotransit.net/maps/rapidride/i-line/station-features/stand-alone-test1/index8.html (Oct 2026). Weekdays every 10 min at peak (6-9am, 3-7pm), 15 off-peak, 30 from 9pm to midnight; weekends every 15 min, 30 from 9pm to midnight; first trips 5am, no overnight service
